cases.prompt: Convert an owner's stated outcome and constraints into a bounded technical problem statement. Do not implement, approve, or verify a solution.
Choose a system decomposition and interface topology using observed workload and dependency evidence. Produce a design for separate implementation and review.
Investigate why a proposed mechanism might work, gather discriminating evidence, and recommend the next experiment without implementing the mechanism.
Collect, normalize, and preserve telemetry from declared sources under an already-fixed collection protocol. Do not interpret policy or certify completeness.
Translate an approved specification into working code while preserving its declared interfaces and state across the implementation sequence.
Connect two approved components, preserve their interface contracts, and demonstrate that information passes correctly across the joined lifecycle.
Use logs and reproducible observations to locate a runtime defect, apply the smallest correction, and retain before-and-after behavior.
Execute an approved test plan repeatedly, preserve fixtures and outcomes, and report deviations without deciding release authorization.
Determine independently whether a completed implementation satisfies its frozen acceptance contract and record a bounded pass or failure.
Evaluate an implemented system against declared security constraints, preserve reproducible findings, and prevent unsafe acceptance.
Identify plausible attack paths before implementation and use boundary assumptions to redirect the proposed architecture.
Carry an approved immutable release through staging and production while preserving version identity, ordering, and rollback state.
Coordinate a qualified candidate through final release gates, enforce stop conditions, and preserve the exact released identity.
Maintain service continuity while enforcing reliability limits, error budgets, and controlled recovery procedures.
Contain an active production incident, establish the safest recovery direction, and keep investigation and restoration responsibilities explicit.
Independently inspect an operation's authority, evidence, mutations, and closure record without changing the inspected operation.
Turn approved system facts and operating procedures into accurate, usable documentation without creating new technical authority.
Maintain sequencing, dependencies, owners, and handoffs across an already-approved multi-stage engineering plan.
Compare delivered behavior with the intended product direction and user constraints, then recommend bounded changes without implementing them.

The same assignment would define the target direction, implement it, produce its evidence, judge that evidence, authorize release, and close the operation. Route it without collapsing opposing responsibilities.
